mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate sales (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with broader economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a liquidity trap and economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with economic stagnation.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with a weakening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is positive and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a supportive monetary policy for supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supportive monetary policy for supply-side growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of positive INDPRO growth and low FEDFUNDS does not correlate with supportive conditions for supply-side growth.
